sources.fact: LBBD87/YA IBIS Barking, Highbridge Road is 0.39ha, 136 net dwellings and planning-permission-status not-permissioned.
YA has point POINT (0.072109 51.533986) and blank geometry; point is not allocation/red-line/title polygon.
Brownfield ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not an HMLR owner/title identification.
Adopted Local Plan allocation YA IBIS Barking has indicative net minimum capacity 136.
Adopted site-allocation proformas identify YA IBIS Barking, Highbridge Road as a housing-led allocation.
Sustainability Appraisal listed YA IBIS Barking at 136 dwellings among sites without planning permission at that stage.
Local Plan HRA identifies YA approximately 5.9km from Epping Forest SAC and subject to in-combination assessment context.
HRA context is plan-level ecological assessment and does not establish a parcel-specific likely significant effect or permission outcome.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted 18 September 2024 and is the starting point for decision-making; allocation still requires planning permission.
The Development Plan includes the adopted LBBD Local Plan and London Plan; plan inclusion does not grant a site-specific consent.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
LBBD directs users to planning applications/decisions for case-specific status; this wave did not locate an exact current YA application reference, so none is inferred.

examples.result: YA remains not-permissioned despite adopted 136-home allocation.
136 is allocation/Brownfield capacity, not consented units.
Blank geometry is not replaced by the YA point or nearby development polygons.
Private/non-public ownership status is not converted into owner name or HMLR title.
Epping Forest HRA proximity/context is not converted into automatic refusal or parcel impact score.
Plan-level HRA is not a project-specific appropriate assessment.
No exact YA planning application was guessed from neighbouring Highbridge/Barking schemes.
Promotion remains zero until exact current YA planning case, site/title polygon and statutory overlays are verified.
